title: Strongly positive bases in rank-two quantum cluster algebras
summary: We prove Conjecture 12 of Lee, Li, Rupel, and Zelevinsky: for arbitrary positive integers \(b,c\), every strongly positive basis of the coefficient-free rank-two quantum cluster algebra \(\mathcal A_v(b,c)\) contains a unique element pointed at each pair in \(\mathbb Z^2\). These pointed elements exhaust the basis.
